scope: Stock Chrome plugin selectAll plus official PDF.js text-layer copy handler for each page. Synthetic ClipboardEvent with isolated in-memory DataTransfer; no system clipboard or native key press. Raw Selection.toString retained separately. Known generated margins are excluded only for a separate body comparison, with occurrence counts retained. Neither raw nor body comparison silently changes Unicode or word order.
